g.text: CPU DRAM bandwidth: median and min–max across repetitions
Dashed lines: 8 channels/socket × 8 bytes × 4400 MT/s; DDR5-4400 verified using DCLK counters (SMBIOS ConfiguredSpeed not read).
Payload: read/write = 1 stream; NT copy = read + write; NT triad = 2 reads + 1 write. Dual-socket values are measured simultaneously.
Error bars retain all recorded repetitions. Rates count application bytes, not memory-controller hardware counters.
High-thread counts may be CPU-throttled in this container; their lower rates do not establish a lower DRAM hardware ceiling.
